en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, classical public building partly obscured by tall deciduous trees. The two‑story masonry structure has pilasters, rectangular windows with simple pediments, and a prominent central entrance reached by steps. Above the roofline rises a distinctive square clock‑tower or cupola with arched windows and a mansard‑style dome. A low fence runs along the foreground and a person in light clothing and a hat stands near the sidewalk, suggesting an early 20th‑century streetscape.
